title: Ensulo Wansi w’Omusenyu
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo bya Quran, omuntu ow’obugumiikiriza obw’ekitalo yayolekagana n’okugezesebwa okwali kugenda okumenya emitima egy’amaanyi ennyo. Buli kimu kyaggyibwako - obugagga, amaka, n'obulamu. Naye okuva mu buziba bw’okuggwaamu essuubi, essaala ey’obwetoowaze yaddibwamu mu ngeri esinga obutasuubirwa. Osobola okuzuula emmeeme eno emboozi yaayo ey’okuzzaawo edda mu myaka?
clues: Nakeberebwa n’okugezesebwa okw’amaanyi ennyo ne kujjukirwa okumala emyaka gyonna.
Nafiirwa buli kimu ekyali kikulu - obugagga bwange, abaana bange, n'obulamu bwange.
Omubiri gwange gwali gujjudde amabwa agaluma, era bonna baali beewala.
Mu kuggwaamu essuubi, nakoowoola Allah, nga ηηamba nti Sitaani yankwatako n’obuzibu n’okubonyaabonyezebwa.
Allah yanziramu n’andagira okukuba ensi n’ekigere kyange.
Okuva mu kifo ekyo kyennyini, ensulo ennyogovu n’ebutuka, Allah n’azzaawo amaka gange n’agakubisaamu emirundi ebiri ng’okusaasira.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Okumira ennyonyi ekika kya whale ennene

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Amaka n’obugagga byaddizibwawo ne bikubisaamu emirundi ebiri
Okuyita mu mazzi agatali gamu mu ngeri ey’obukuumi
Okuzaalibwa kw'omwana ow'obulenzi mu ngeri ey'ekyamagero mu bukadde
outcome.answer: Amaka n’obugagga byaddizibwawo ne bikubisaamu emirundi ebiri

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
